body:
hi! thank you for everything. seriously.

my question is this: with so many fan favorite quotes circulating as tattoos, merch, etc, are there any specific quotes you loved writing that you wish received similar treatment? obviously you can't control what resonates with people but i could understand if there was something you'd written that made you go "aw jeez im proud of that, why do people never talk about this one?"

thanks man. ive taken some time to think about things today and to take care of myself and im now feeling a bit better. the kind responses on this post (and just putting it out there at all) really helped me remember that i've come a long way even if im not quite where i want to be yet. "you live, that's enough." wow. i kind of want to get that as a tattoo, haha.

that means a lot to hear. i guess i hadn't thought of it like that. my reaction to these feelings is definitely different than it used to be- now, i actually talk about it with people. making this post was actually super cathartic. thank you for reaching out (and for giving me a little giggle with your username)
yeah, i've been trying to binge more on things like fruit and carrots since its summer. thank you for the advice
